question.text: A 47-year-old male presents to the clinic with complaints of sudden mood swings ranging from extreme happiness to severe anxiety, coupled with episodic heart palpitations and tremors that have been progressively worsening over the past three months. His medical history reveals no psychiatric disorders or cardiovascular anomalies. Upon evaluation, his heart rate shows significant variability, and sleep studies indicate disrupted REM cycles. Diagnostic GIS imaging notes hyperactivity in an organ located adjacent to the heart. Based on the given symptoms and diagnostic findings, which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
